general_information.Description: This course consists of the study of hotel front office procedures, with the primary focus is the front office, housekeeping, reservations, and night audit departments. Other departments are discussed to provide and understanding of how these departments relate to the front office and how they operate to enhance the guest experience. The course gives students a real world understanding of the hotel industry balancing its past, present and future. It reveals the inner workings of a hotel in a way that both promotes learning and interest for the students, preparing them for what to expect in the current and future hotel market. -Description:The course focuses on the front office, housekeeping, F&B and how they relate to each other in order to provide excellent service to customers. Other departments are also explained to provide a full understanding of the organization of a hotel. Students are to practice their analyzing and problem solving skills with up-to-date real life example and current trends. -Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work - Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements. 3) Completion Criteria: Every on-going assessment component > 0; Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >= 4
general_information.StudentTasks: Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate highly professional attitude and discipline to the team, instructor and school regulation.
Explain the development of the lodging industry, the, definition of green hotels and the relation among department in the hotel divisions.
Describe the functions and operation of the various tasks, systems, forms, equipment and types of reservation used in the front office.
Illustrate the registration, selling, denying accommodation process and guestroom sales techniques that helps ensure a hotel's profitability.
Develop an efficient communication skill and security program in front office department to meet guest satisfaction and to resolve with guest complaints.
Understand and compute all transaction and the key formula for measuring hotel revenue that help to built hotel strategies for profit driven purposes
Demonstrate how rooms are asigned to housekeepers, housekeeping standards, check-out and settlement procedures
Explain the front office audit functions and process
Develop the management functions such as forecasting,evaluate the efficiency of front office operations and human resources management

assessments.No Question: Maximum length of the group assignment should be 10 pages maximum excluding appendices
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on topics of studied units
assessments.Grading Guide: Presentation in class and submission via email or anycourse supporting platfrom
assessments.Note: Four or five students per group. Groups and groups ideas are determined on the third session of the course. Work will be break down into stages and examined during the course. Final work to be submitted prior to the presentation of the topic .All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in both soft and hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission Evaluation will be based on both presentation and written report (reccommded 30%, 70% accordingly
